title: Access transition function
statement: For a Boolean mode parameter, define the transition function of the four-work-tape access procedure on its access states by the specified cases: it performs the read, comparison, counter-update, restoration, and answer steps, and returns the corresponding one-step machine action.
caveat: The definition is a long case-based transition table; this summary names its operations but does not reproduce every branch.
